page_notes.469: 4 Hole - Slotted Locking Zinc Hinge: 12085 and 12086 extracted (15-badged); 12087 skipped as metric-only (45). Metric suggested-hardware rows skipped.
page_notes.470: Lite Panel Hinge 12097 (15/40) extracted; included M5 panel hardware has no part numbers (recorded in notes); suggested T-slot hardware 3487 attached.
page_notes.471: Safety Hinge With Interlock Switch: 22100 and 22101 extracted under a merged 15/30/40/45 badge; 15/40 suggested hardware row (11-6312 bolt, 13024 T-nut) attached.
page_notes.472: Plastic Door Handle: 15 series rows 2061, 2881, 2060, 2880 extracted; 10 series (2062, 2882) and metric (25-/40-) rows skipped.
page_notes.473: Offset Plastic Handle 2079 (10/15) extracted with included 15 series hardware 75-3804; 40-2079 metric skipped.
page_notes.474: Ergonomic Plastic Handle 12000 (15/40/45) extracted with suggested hardware 3454.
page_notes.475: Aluminum Door Handle: 2884-2887 (10/15) extracted with 15 series hardware 3064 + 3382; metric 40-288x rows skipped.
page_notes.477: Steel Door Handle 2070 and 65-2070 (both badged F/M) extracted with included hardware 3024; required machining (Plastic Panel Milling, page 11-39) has no service number so no machining_service part was created.

corrected: 22100: name 'Safety Hinge With Interlock Switch - Switch Hinge' -> 'Safety Hinge With Interlock Switch - Safety Interlock Switch' (distinguishing word taken from the printed Description column)
22100: description removed unprinted claim 'for guarding doors on T-slot frames'
22100: notes removed unprinted claim '22101 is the companion hinge without switch'
22101: description removed unprinted claims '(no switch)' and 'used alongside the 22100 switch hinge'
remaining_doubts: 469: 3214 (hex nut) and 3260 (washer) are listed as separate suggested_hardware entries without qty because the table prints qty 2 only for the 3117 bolt row.
470: 12097 Included Hardware (1 M5 Screw, 1 M5 Hex Nut, 1 M5 Washer) has no part numbers, so it stays in notes and is not in suggested_hardware.
471: the 15/40 suggested-hardware row (11-6312 + 13024) is attached to both 22100 and 22101; the page does not say whether it applies to the switch, the hinge, or both.
473/477: the Included Hardware rows (75-3804 for 2079, 3024 for 2070/65-2070) are recorded under suggested_hardware with context 'Included Hardware'.

477: 65-2070 is kept because its row has the F badge (with M), even though its dimensions are in mm. The required machining (Steel Door Handle Plastic Panel Milling, ref 11-39) has no service number and no 15 badge, so no machining_service part was created.
